definitions.gloss: horse racing ticket; betting slip; racing bet
definitions.explanation: A ticket purchased to bet on horse races, representing a wager on which horse or combination of horses will win, place, or show. Horse racing is one of the few forms of legal gambling in Japan.

examples.english: To buy a horse racing ticket.

examples.japanese: {馬券|ばけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たって→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦{大喜|おおよろこ}び→大喜び：28880_ooyorokobi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was overjoyed when my racing bet won.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{競馬場|けいばじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧{馬券|ばけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: My father's weekly pleasure is going to the racetrack on Sundays to buy betting tickets.

notes:
Composed of {馬|ば} (horse) + ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket/voucher). Formally called {勝馬投票券|かちうまとうひょうけん} (winning horse voting ticket). Horse racing (⟦{競馬|けいば}→競馬：00207_keiba⟧) is one of the major forms of legalized gambling in Japan, along with bicycle racing, boat racing, and motorcycle racing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {馬券|ばけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a racing ticket
- {馬券|ばけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to win on a racing bet
- {馬券|ばけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to lose a racing bet
- {馬券|ばけん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: ticket-selling area at a racetrack

TYPES OF BETS:
- {単勝|たんしょう}: win (picking the first-place horse)
- {複勝|ふくしょう}: place (picking a top-three horse)
- {馬連|うまれん}: quinella (picking first and second in any order)
- {三連単|さんれんたん}: trifecta (first, second, third in exact order)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Horse racing is regulated by the JRA (⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧{競馬会|けいばかい}) and local governments. {馬券|ばけん} can be purchased at racetracks, off-track betting facilities, and online.
